name: io.usefulapi/bonusly
title: Bonusly MCP by usefulapi
description: Read bonuses, users, achievements and redemptions; give or edit bonuses in Bonusly.

tools.name: bonusly_whoami
tools.description: Show which company the API token belongs to, its application name, the scopes it holds, and the user it acts as, if any. Use it first to see what this connection can do. GET /api/public/whoami.

tools.name: bonusly_get_company
tools.description: Return the company of the token's user. GET /api/v1/companies/show.

tools.name: bonusly_get_me
tools.description: Return the user the token acts as. Needs a user token; a company-scoped token gets HTTP 400. GET /api/v1/users/me.

tools.name: bonusly_list_users
tools.description: List users in the company. Set include_archived to also see deactivated users. GET /api/v1/users.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination.

email.description: Only users whose email contains this text (case-insensitive).

tools.name: bonusly_get_user
tools.description: Return one user by id, scoped to the token's company. GET /api/v1/users/{id}.

tools.name: bonusly_autocomplete_users
tools.description: Find users whose display name, username or email matches a search text, ranked by relevance. Returns a compact list. Use it to find the id of a person before a bonus. GET /api/v1/users/autocomplete.

search.description: Text to match against display name, username or email.

include_non_receivable.description: Include users who cannot receive bonuses.

tools.name: bonusly_list_bonuses
tools.description: List bonuses (peer recognitions) in the company. Filter by time, giver, receiver or hashtag. GET /api/v1/bonuses.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination.

start_time.description: Only bonuses created at or after this time.

end_time.description: Only bonuses created at or before this time.

giver_email.description: Only bonuses given by the user with this email.

receiver_email.description: Only bonuses received by the user with this email.

hashtag.description: Only bonuses with this hashtag, for example #teamwork.

tools.name: bonusly_get_bonus
tools.description: Return one bonus by id. GET /api/v1/bonuses/{id}.

include_children.description: Include the full list of child bonuses.

tools.name: bonusly_list_user_bonuses
tools.description: List the bonuses one user gave or received. Set role to giver or receiver to narrow it. GET /api/v1/users/{id}/bonuses.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination.

role.description: Only bonuses where the user gave or received.

tools.name: bonusly_list_achievements
tools.description: List the 50 most recent achievements earned by users in the company. GET /api/v1/achievements.

tools.name: bonusly_list_user_achievements
tools.description: List the achievements one user has earned. GET /api/v1/users/{id}/achievements.

tools.name: bonusly_list_redemptions
tools.description: List fulfilled reward redemptions for the company, newest first. Admin tokens only: other tokens get HTTP 403. GET /api/v1/redemptions.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination.

tools.name: bonusly_get_redemption
tools.description: Return one reward redemption by id, scoped to the token's company. GET /api/v1/redemptions/{id}.

tools.name: bonusly_list_user_redemptions
tools.description: List the reward redemptions of one user. GET /api/v1/users/{id}/redemptions.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination.

tools.name: bonusly_list_custom_rewards_redemptions
tools.description: List redemptions of the company's own custom catalog items (for example branded swag), filtered by state. Admin token required. GET /api/v1/custom_rewards_redemptions.

skip.description: Number of records to skip, for pagination.

fulfillment_partner.description: Only redemptions handled by this partner (exact match, case-insensitive).

tools.name: bonusly_create_bonus
tools.description: WRITE: give a bonus. Bonusly parses the reason for the amount, the @recipients and the #hashtags, for example '+10 @alice @bob for shipping #teamwork'. The tool does not send the privacy option. Admin tokens may set giver_email to give on behalf of another user. POST /api/v1/bonuses.

reason.description: Bonus text with +amount, @mentions and #hashtags, for example '+10 @alice for shipping #teamwork'.

giver_email.description: Admin tokens only: give the bonus as this user.

tools.name: bonusly_update_bonus
tools.description: WRITE: change the reason text of one bonus. Bonusly allows this only within a limited edit window after creation (the BonusEditing policy); admins may edit other users' bonuses in that window. PUT /api/v1/bonuses/{id}.
